extDescription.message: Send links to UTD for fast, safety-checked downloads.

hint.message: Right-click a link or video to download it quickly.

openedForQuality.message: Opened UTD to pick the quality.

sendFailed.message: Couldn't send the request to UTD.

notRunning.message: UTD isn't running. Open UTD and try again.

notConnected.message: Can't reach UTD. Make sure UTD is running and browser integration is on.

readLinksFailed.message: Couldn't read the links on this page.

noLinks.message: No downloadable links found on this page.

driveFolder.message: This is a Google Drive folder, not a file. Open the file in its own page, then try again.

videoSignIn.message: This video needs sign-in. Sign in on the site, then try again.

videoButtonSwitch.message: Show the "Download this video" button on pages

tooManyLinks.message: Too many links in one send.

openedForChannel.message: Opened UTD to download the whole channel.

openedForLinks.message: Opened UTD to pick the links.

authSensitive.message: Sensitive site: allow each download yourself.

takeoverHint.message: Hold Alt while clicking to let the browser download.
